repo.description: A Bitcoin node in 100% AI-generated x86-64 assembly. Fully verifies consensus from genesis; UTXO set proven byte-identical to Bitcoin Core (MuHash-exact); follows mainnet live; serves most of Core's RPC surface incl. getblocktemplate/submitblock/scantxoutset. C/Python are oracles and harnesses only. Unaudited — do not run this.
